items.title: Emergency Technical Audit
items.description: Immediately investigate Google Analytics tracking code, server logs, and site functionality. Check for broken tracking implementation, server errors, or CDN issues preventing proper data collection and user access.
items.expectedImpact: Restore traffic visibility and identify root cause of 100% traffic loss

items.title: SERP Snippet Optimization
items.description: Review and optimize title tags and meta descriptions for top-ranking pages, especially 'aged lead store' and insurance-related terms. Ensure compelling CTAs that differentiate from competitors.
items.expectedImpact: Improve CTR from current 0% to historical 0.23% or higher

items.title: Search Console Deep Dive
items.description: Review Coverage report for indexing issues, check for crawl errors, and examine any security issues or manual actions. Verify robots.txt and sitemap functionality.
items.expectedImpact: Identify and resolve search engine access barriers

items.title: Capitalize on Search Momentum
items.description: With impressions up 127.6%, create targeted landing pages for high-impression, low-click queries like 'aged mortgage leads' (5 impressions, pos 42.8) and 'insurance leads cost' (6 impressions, pos 42.7).
items.expectedImpact: Convert increased visibility into actual traffic and clicks

items.title: Emergency Technical Audit and Site Recovery
items.description: Immediately check for site downtime, server errors, robots.txt blocks, or Google penalties. Verify site accessibility, SSL certificates, and core web vitals. Check Google Search Console for crawl errors, manual actions, or security issues.
items.expectedImpact: Restore basic site functionality and traffic within 24-48 hours

items.title: Optimize Meta Descriptions for High-Impression Queries
items.description: Rewrite meta descriptions for pages ranking for 'aged lead store' (pos 17.3), 'aged insurance leads' (pos 33), and cost-related queries. Focus on compelling CTAs like 'Compare Prices', 'Free Calculator', or 'Exclusive Reviews'.
items.expectedImpact: Increase CTR from 0% to 2-5% within 2 weeks

items.title: Create Dedicated Cost Comparison Landing Pages
items.description: Build targeted pages for high-impression cost queries: 'auto insurance leads cost', 'cost of insurance leads', 'how much do life insurance leads cost'. Include pricing tables, calculators, and affiliate links to AgedLeadStore.com.
items.expectedImpact: Capture 10-15 additional clicks weekly from cost-focused searches

items.title: Content Freshness Campaign
items.description: Update the aged lead industry statistics page and economics of aged leads content with 2024 data, new case studies, and current market insights to improve rankings and relevance.
items.expectedImpact: Improve average position from 30.3 to 20-25 range

items.title: Title Tag and Meta Description Optimization
items.description: Rewrite title tags and meta descriptions for pages ranking positions 11-30 to improve CTR. Focus on 'aged lead store reviews' (pos 11.7) and 'auto insurance lead cost' (pos 12.7) pages first.
items.expectedImpact: Increase CTR by 2-5x for existing impressions, potentially driving 10-20 daily clicks

items.title: Mobile Experience Enhancement
items.description: With mobile generating the only click (1 click from 21 mobile impressions vs 0 clicks from 207 desktop impressions), optimize mobile user experience and page speed for the /providers page.
items.expectedImpact: Improve mobile conversion rates and expand mobile traffic capture

items.title: Optimize High-Ranking Low-CTR Pages
items.description: Focus on pages ranking in positions 8-17 with zero clicks: aged-lead-industry-statistics (pos 9.0), aged-lead-store provider page (pos 11.7), and 7-day follow-up cadence (pos 8.1). Improve titles and meta descriptions.
items.expectedImpact: Increase CTR from current 0.44% to 1-2% for top-ranking pages

items.title: Content Freshness Initiative
items.description: Update top-performing pages like 'aged-lead-industry-statistics' and 'economics-of-aged-leads' with recent data and insights. Add current market trends and pricing information.
items.expectedImpact: Improve search rankings and user engagement once technical issues are resolved

items.title: Enhance Calculator Tool Visibility
items.description: Improve rankings for CPL calculator (pos 87-95) by adding more detailed explanations, industry benchmarks, and related tools. Create supporting content around lead cost calculations.
items.expectedImpact: Move calculator pages to positions 20-30, increasing impressions by 50%

items.title: Expand Aged Lead Store Review Content
items.description: Leverage strong position 11-12 rankings for 'aged lead store reviews' by adding more detailed comparison content, user testimonials, and pricing analysis to drive affiliate conversions.
items.expectedImpact: Increase affiliate click-through rate and improve rankings to position 5-8

items.title: Calculator Tool Enhancement
items.description: Optimize the CPL calculator page (currently pos 91.3) with better UX, mobile responsiveness, and additional lead cost scenarios for different verticals to capture more long-tail queries.
items.expectedImpact: Move calculator pages into top 30 positions, increase impressions by 50%

items.title: Comparison Content Expansion
items.description: Create more detailed comparison pages for lead providers, building on the existing 'badass insurance leads vs ileads' content that ranks at position 14.6.
items.expectedImpact: Capture more commercial intent queries and improve affiliate conversions

items.title: Content Expansion for High-Impression Queries
items.description: Create dedicated landing pages or expand existing content for 'aged mortgage leads' (9 impressions, pos 44.2) and 'auto insurance leads cost' (6 impressions, pos 23.0) to capture more search volume.
items.expectedImpact: Improve positions by 10-15 spots and increase impression volume by 50%

items.title: Internal Linking Strategy
items.description: Implement strategic internal linking between high-performing pages like 'aged-lead-industry-statistics' (pos 3.0) and conversion-focused pages to distribute link equity and improve rankings.
items.expectedImpact: Boost average positions by 5-10 spots across target pages

items.title: Content Gap Analysis
items.description: Develop content targeting queries showing in positions 60-90+ like 'how much do insurance leads cost' (pos 73) and 'cpl calculator' (pos 88) to capture long-tail search volume.
items.expectedImpact: Expand search footprint and capture additional qualified traffic

items.title: Long-tail Keyword Expansion
items.description: Target specific queries like 'how much do mortgage trigger leads cost' (pos 56.8) and 'auto insurance lead cost' (pos 23.0) with dedicated content pieces.
items.expectedImpact: Increase impressions and capture more qualified traffic for affiliate conversions

items.title: Mobile Experience Optimization
items.description: Despite low mobile impressions (21 vs 252 desktop), optimize mobile page speed and user experience as mobile traffic typically converts better for local service queries.
items.expectedImpact: Improve mobile rankings and capture additional 15-20% traffic when issues are resolved
